purpose: Requirements for the information a ToC manages, AI-generated field limits, change detection via content hashes, and the build/rebuild flow that updates and commits a ToC.
summary: Information requirements for document info, section entries, and reference entries, including acquisition method and whether user documents are written to
Limits on AI-generated fields: description limit L and internal tolerance limit H = floor(L x 1.3), with H never shown to the generating AI
ToC metadata: ToC identification key and normalized Index target specification stored for re-interpretation and rebuild detection
Change detection (FR-003, FR-011, FR-012): move/rename recognition, document-level and section-level change detection
Content hash definition: SHA-256 of raw text, reference link definition lines excluded, 12-digit prefix recorded in link titles
Timing of updating reflected hashes: updated together with ToC commit, unchanged on failure
Change set detection process: classifying new, body change, reference change, move/rename, departure, and unchanged
ToC build/rebuild (FR-004, FR-005): update plan, document info generation, reference reconstruction, candidate validation, and atomic commit
Completion result: counts on standard output and full details written to a work file (D-059)
Acceptance criteria AC-001 to AC-027 for moves, regeneration suppression, tolerance, rebuild failure, and change types
tasks: Designing or implementing ToC build and rebuild
Implementing change detection and change set classification
Implementing AI-generated field generation and validation
Defining the ToC data model and metadata
Designing completion result output of index building
Writing tests for ToC acceptance criteria
Reviewing the reference check result recording in ToC
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — [ToC]管理
